name: AI Deep Dive — SHAZ — 2026-07-14
rationale: SharonAI Holdings (SHAZ) is a pure-play neocloud and accelerated compute provider anchored by Situational Awareness L.P.'s 19.9% stake and a $1.6B capital raise. The company's strategic collaboration with Nvidia to deploy a 72MW AI factory and 40,000 Grace Blackwell GB300 GPUs in Australia positions it for an explosive revenue ramp from TTM $1.57M to over $1.35B by 2027. We model a hypergrowth-exception 5-year CAGR, factoring in high initial growth and long-term dilution from Senior Notes/Warrants.

bear.rationale: Bear case models severe dilution from convertible senior notes (+5%/year) and intense GPU cloud pricing pressure as hyperscalers enter the market. Year 5 revenue reaches $750M with exit margins depressed to 10% and a low 12x P/E multiplier.
risks: Hyperscaler price wars erode GPU cloud rental yields
Excessive share dilution from warrant and senior note conversions

base.rationale: Base case models successful deployment of the 72MW AI factory in Australia, matching analyst forecasts of $1.35B in 2027 and expanding to $2.50B in Year 5. Exit net margin of 18% is typical for scaled neocloud providers, and 20x P/E reflects premium sovereign positioning.
risks: Construction or power hookup delays at the Australian datacenter site

bull.rationale: Bull case models SHAZ maintaining its lead in APAC sovereign AI cloud capacity. Year 5 revenue reaches $3.2B with high-margin premium Blackwell leases achieving 25% net margins. Capped dilution at 1% and premium 28x exit P/E.
risks: Extreme macro supply chain disruptions in the APAC region

aiThesis.rationale: SharonAI represents a high-conviction bet on BTM AI infrastructure buildout. Backed by Aschenbrenner's 19.9% stake, it is positioned to be a dominant neocloud player in Australia.

analyticsLog.shareCountMethod: Diluted share count adjusted for private placement
